timeline.text: A parent checks the kids' calendar screen and sees nothing but homework.
No assignment that day? The screen looks blank, as if school never happened.
Now the calendar lists every subject in the real timetable order, homework attached only where it exists.
The homework line itself used to scroll sideways, hard to read at a glance.
Now it shrinks to fit instead, down to fifty-five percent, before it's ever cut off.
